mapper.update: UPDATE erp_production_order_step SET reported_qty = reported_qty + #{reportedQty}, qualified_qty = qualified_qty + #{qualifiedQty}, scrap_qty = scrap_qty + #{scrapQty} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND step_status = 1 AND reported_qty + scrap_qty + #{reportedQty} + #{scrapQty} <= plan_qty
